summary: Correct, minimal fix that matches Django's actual merged solution: post_init is only connected when width_field/height_field exist, eliminating the noop signal on the hot init path. The redundant has_dimension_fields guard in update_dimension_fields is safely removable since the signal now only fires for fields that have dimension fields.

issues.description: ImageFileDescriptor.__set__ still calls update_dimension_fields(force=True) unconditionally on reassignment when previous_file is not None. With the has_dimension_fields early-return removed, an ImageField WITHOUT width/height fields now reads file.width/file.height (image I/O) and discards them on every reassignment, whereas before it returned immediately. Narrow path (reassigning an already-set value), so minor, not blocking.
